analysis: Examined unit 9 (base lines 3081-3442 of ClusterOnboardingFlow.swift: startOutcome, register, waitWithRows, provision/move, busy, mailbox) and unit 10 (head lines 1-485: ClusterServingScope, ClusterServingChoice, request/private qualification validation, command naming, pending-registration marks, mode structs). The visible patch adds operations.stopsAsked and serveUnlessStopped (head 1518-1525), an optional hook letting a start's serve be refused as stopped if a stop was requested since a counted baseline, checked under the leader's start lock. provision now takes stopsBefore (head 2852). This is a race fix for local onboarding UX/availability (A-018) that cannot widen trust. Scope handling at head 53-67 falls back to loopback for invalid saved binds and rejects invalid carried binds; the default bind 0.0.0.0 is pre-existing (owner decision) and API-key gated per the line text. No coordinator authorization, attestation (TB-009/TB-011), encryption (A-001/A-003) or billing paths are changed in visible units; registration decisions remain coordinator-side (register() only reports lines). Private image qualification refusal (head 208-230) requires local-only scope and exact model ID plus leader role, unchanged in visible form. Coverage limits: many changed head ranges (2901-3539) were not in this batch's head units, including the serveUnlessStopped call sites and the live implementation of the stop counter/lock; integration should confirm the live implementation fails safe (nil → plain serve) and that the stop counter in ClusterSetupRecord cannot be manipulated by the member Mac to block starts beyond the existing local DoS posture (T-059/T-060 analog). No regression identified.
